method.modes: LocalPlannerMode::lattice (default) or five_offsets (decision 0004, kept for comparison)
method.straight: no blockage, or reference line clear and |offset| <= 1 m: one prediction, identical to the five-offset planner
method.return: reference line clear of every blockage but |offset| > 1 m, or failing only the model envelope: cheapest lattice path ending on the reference, if clear
method.pass: reference line enters a blockage: cheapest path passing the nearest blockage on its left and on its right; the clear one of least cost
method.brake: no pass clear: decision 0004's stopping cap, aiming at the centre of the widest gap across the corridor less the half width, or the reference without a gap
method.search: from the node nearest the car's offset on the first layer >= 1 m ahead, over layers within 60 m or just past the blockage; dynamic programme over edges
method.path_geometry: straight segments between nodes from the car's station and offset, pursued through ControlIntent::path; quintic edges supply only offline cost
method.admissible_segment: inside the corridor less 0.9 m; clear of every blockage widened by 0.9 m, and before it by a pursuit distance; a pass keeps to its side of its blockage; tested every 0.5 m
method.cost: sum of edges' offline cost + 50000 * share^2 * span per slope change + 10000 * |last node offset|; share = |delta slope| / span * v^2 / lateral budget, v the larger of the car's and the planned speed there; share > 1 not allowed, including the final turn parallel to the reference
method.lateral_budget: envelope_fraction * min(left, right lateral limit) under the envelope plan, else lateral_grip_fraction * grip * g
method.commitment: a new path for the previous choice's action keeps its points within a pursuit distance when still clear and continues from the node reached there
method.offline_cost_change: reference_deviation_limit 10000 -> 40000 (saturates at 4 m); decision 0021's lattice counts are unchanged, its evidence costs used the old limit
